title: ReplenishmentOrchestratorWorkflowOutput
description: Result of one Replenishment Orchestrator run. The orchestrator never approves anything: every outcome that leads to stock movement or spending ends at a human decision in the owning module.

status.description: PendingApproval: a procurement proposal awaits approval. TransferRecommended: Inventory Optimization recommends a transfer, awaiting approval in the Inventory module. NoActionRequired: stock is above the reorder level. QuantityConflict: the forecast gives no positive order quantity although Inventory Optimization recommends a reorder (integration decision D12); a human must decide. NoEligibleSupplier: Supplier Evaluation selected no quotation. ChecksFailed: the Procurement Coordinator's budget/business-rule checks failed. InvalidInput: the objective failed validation. Failed: an agent or a contract check failed.

nextAction.description: What a human does next, and where.

childWorkflows.description: Ids linking this run to each agent's own record.
